concepts.gloss_en: Desecration of the Sabbath; equated with the aspect of חלל (void) / short steps
The rectification/repair of Sabbath desecration — a state/process about חלול שבת, not the desecration itself

members.note: representative; a rectified-state predicate on חלול שבת (per rule 4, action/state about X ≠ X)

notes: Same Torah (lm1:277) and shared token חלול שבת, but 'נתתקן חלול שבת' names the rectification of the desecration, not the desecration. Kept separate per rule 4 (action/state about X ≠ X).
